techniques.evidence: src-tauri/db/src/byom.rs:305 persists the policy under one settings key with no version, diff, blast radius or approver; src/lib/bindings/ProviderAuditEntry.ts:6 carries rule names but no policy version, so an audit cannot tell 'rule violated' from 'rule did not exist yet'

src-tauri/src/engine/failover.rs:770 filters blocked providers out of the chain without a reason, and src-tauri/src/engine/runner/mod.rs:2393 reports the empty chain as 'All providers failed or have open circuit breakers', not a named policy-exhausted failure
src/features/settings/sub_byom/components/ByomAuditLog.tsx:77 and :84 surface the routing and compliance rule that decided each call
